entities.summary: Horacio Arturo Ferrer Ezcurra was a Uruguayan–Argentine poet, broadcaster, reciter and tango lyricist. He is particularly well known for having composed the lyrics for tangos by Astor Piazzolla, such as Balada para un loco and Chiquilín de Bachín.
